transfer.visualRole: supporting-component: numbered process strip and named testimonial anatomy for a technical B2B credibility case
principles: Complex technical manufacturing credibility is carried by a numbered O1 through O7 horizontal process strip, one capability per step with a plain numeral plus short label - the same structural idea as UNIENS' own existing four-step consignment settlement flow but proven at a more confident visual scale.

Named third-party testimonial quotes pairing customer logo, role, and company substitute for stock trust badges - real named evidence over generic claims, directly analogous to what UNIENS' own real license, patent, and GMP numbers already provide.
A closing numeric stats counter is the single most decorative moment on an otherwise restrained, dense, technical page - confirms one committed signature moment is enough register, not several.
